info.title: worker-protocol — the Descriptor
info.description: The one route this protocol fixes, and the whole of what every Worker owes. Every other address is declared in the document this answers (ENDP-1).

servers.description: DESC-3. The Worker's enrolled base URL: one absolute `https` URL, with or without a path.

baseUrl.description: Read from the Worker's Descriptor and resolved per DESC-12. Never assembled by a caller (ENDP-1). The default is `/` and not a host on purpose: a client that was never given an address should fail at its own origin rather than reach somebody else's.

get.description: DESC-5. Reading a Descriptor is a GET and changes nothing. REG-21 has the Worker accept the credential recorded for it here as on every other address.

parameters.name: Worker-Protocol-Capability-Version
parameters.description: ENDP-6. The Capability version the caller expects. A Worker that cannot answer it refuses the request whole with `400` and `unsupported_version`, and never substitutes its own.

Worker-Protocol-Edition.description: ENDP-5. The edition that produced this answer. A caller that sees one it did not expect re-reads the Descriptor rather than parsing the body.

Worker-Protocol-Capability-Version.description: ENDP-5. The Capability version that produced this answer.
